name: PDT 3.7
what_it_is: PHP Development Tools (PDT) encompasses the development components necessary to develop PHP-based Web Applications and facilitates extensibility. It leverages the existing Web Tools Project in providing developers with PHP capabilities. PDT 3.7.0 will improve PHP 7 support. It provides improvements in performance, usability and consistency. The PDT source code is contained in the org.eclipse.pdt.git repo and for this release is tagged R3_7_0.
